photos.name: Accra, June 2022
photos.meaning: The street is flooded and the water can stall cars and knock over bikes and people.
photos.advice: Do not try to drive or ride through, move to higher ground.

photos.name: Kibra, Nairobi, June 2026
photos.meaning: Muddy water has filled homes and is flowing fast beside them.
photos.advice: Stay out of the water and move to higher ground.

photos.name: Maiduguri, Sep 2024
photos.meaning: Floodwater is sitting around the homes and is dirty with mud and rubbish.
photos.advice: Stay out of the water and keep away from the broken buildings.
